headline: Generative protein and molecular models pairing latent control with geometric evaluation
label: Generative Molecular Design Models
summary: Recent preprints pair generative protein and molecular models with latent steering, inference-time search, and geometric benchmarks.
synthesis: The dominant thread is explicit steering of learned generators toward a design objective. ConforNets applies channel-wise affine transforms to AF3 pre-Pairformer pair latents to steer conformational sampling, and RosettaSearch uses LLMs as generative optimizers in an inference-time multi-objective search for backbone-conditioned sequence design. Quotient-space diffusion removes SE(3) redundancy for molecular structure generation, while GeomMotif provides 57 PDB-derived tasks for scoring arbitrary geometric motif preservation with scRMSD and pLDDT. Surleton jointly models backbone and surface geometry for inverse folding. What is new is the coupling of generative models with direct latent control or with evaluation over structure predictors. AlphaInterp applies causal activation patching to AF3 internals, linking Pairformer latent geometry and confidence to evolutionary dependence. HyperEvoGen contributes only the generative framing through a hyperbolic variational autoencoder for protein embeddings.
